art_instructions: Show a cozy Greek classroom in bright natural light from large windows on the left, with soft blue, whitewashed walls and exposed wooden beams. Center a low, honey-oak group table on a colorful geometric woven rug; a teacher’s podium with blue-and-white pottery and a potted green plant sit in the background. On the table, place one large open picture book with oversized, clear Greek letters on the page (e.g., Α Β Γ), leaving a clear expanse of tabletop on the far side of the book. Panda sits front-left at the table on a low chair, gently holding the bottom corner of the page as if turning it, reading with a focused, slightly open mouth; a small picture book peeks from a pouch on his chair. Koala sits front-right, small and round with a leaf-green scarf, tracing a line of letters on the open page with her right paw; her tiny acorn-brown backpack hangs on her chair back; her expression is calm and pleased. Dinosaur stands behind the table between Panda and Koala, pea-green with a mint belly and little dorsal nubs, leaning forward to look through a child-safe magnifying glass at the letters; his small red backpack rests on the floor by his feet; he smiles in cheerful concentration. Owl perches at kids’ eye level on a low stool at the near edge of the table, green scarf on and tiny satchel beside her; one wing extends to indicate a word in the book, eyes warm and encouraging. No mice appear in this scene; the focus is all four animals quietly reading together in the school.
